# A 30.00 invoice with a 50.00 split attached by `txn_split_guid:`, which
# names a split outright and does not compare it to what is owed — so the lot
# is 20.00 past zero before the second block is read.
#
# The second block retargets another 50.00 transaction. There is nothing left
# for it to settle, and that is what the refusal has to say: subtracting a
# negative outstanding from the transaction's amount reports a residual of
# 70.00 and quotes "−20.00 this payment can take", which is arithmetic about a
# state nobody can act on.
invoice "INV-PAST-ZERO"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "B"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 30
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-02-28
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-PAST-ZERO"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-05
		amount: 50
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "FIRST_TXN_GUID"
		txn_split_guid: "FIRST_SPLIT_GUID"
		memo: "First"
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-12
		amount: 50
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "SECOND_TXN_GUID"
		prepayment: 20
		memo: "Second"
